overview_description.description:
bluworks is a workforce management platform built for businesses managing dynamic teams across multiple locations. It brings scheduling, attendance tracking, payroll automation, and leave management into a single system, giving HR, operations, finance, and business owners real-time visibility into labor costs and workforce coverage.

Key features include GPS-verified clock-ins, automated Egyptian tax and social insurance calculations, employee self-service through a mobile app, and live dashboards for attendance and labor performance across every branch.

bluworks is trusted by companies including Diwan Bookstores, Cilantro, Ariika, and El Sagheer Salons.

about_short_description.short_description: bluworks is a workforce management platform for scheduling, attendance, payroll, and leave management.

product.name: Scheduling
product.description: A tool to create, update, and share employee work schedules with shift and location assignments, including instant notifications of changes.

product.name: Attendance Tracking
product.description: A system for real-time tracking of employee attendance, including clock-in/out via mobile with geo-fencing and rules for late arrivals or absences.

product.name: Leave Management
product.description: A digital system to manage employee leave requests, approvals, leave policies, and leave balance tracking with notifications.

product.name: Incentives & Penalties
product.description: A system to digitize and automate employee incentive schemes and penalty filings, linked directly to payroll.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: An automated payroll system that calculates salaries including bonuses, penalties, taxes, and insurance, ensuring compliance with local regulations.

product.name: Employee Digital Files
product.description: A secure digital repository for storing and accessing employee documents and information with alerts for missing or expiring files.
